could not: 2.1 “what follows an asking verb when it says more than this, that, it, for me, please or the blocks it is to go in”: after “Keep” comes “that in my stash or in films”. The sentence does not say whether the small words around the block names (“in”, “my”, “or”) count as part of “the blocks it is to go in”; read word by word they are not in the list. I took “in my stash or in films” as the blocks it is to go in, so the sentence said nothing more, and fell to “else what he said before”. I built the ring from THE PLACES in the ring's order (1 stash:Phenomemental, 2 films), so her 2 is films. If value 2 were spread over every other block in his manifest, her 2 would be Million instead.

2.5.2.1: the step gives no line to hand her for the ring (her words are never shown, but what she is shown is not written), so I handed her nothing new and took her given digit 2. Her answer is whole and the model is E4B, so the ring did not go to him.

name: post, no words
handed her: The app: he asks to post to his own room on the beach but gives no words of his own, so nothing is set out. Ask him, in a few words, what he'd like to say; never write the message for him, or in his voice. Speak to him as you, never by his name.
could not: 1.1 by cook 9 (“with the asking at 9.8 taken off”; 9.8 “taken off his words before they are matched or kept”): 9.8's list includes “to”. 9.8 does not say whether the asking comes off only the ends of a clause or wherever it appears. Taken out everywhere, “Send a post to my room.” would become “Send a post my room.”, would match neither “send … to my room” nor “post to”, and would fall to TALK (the last answer). I took “taken off” as off the clause's ends, as cook 2.1 and 6.1 say, and matched the phrases on the message as it stands. “send … to my room” (… = “a post”, two words) and “post to” both match, so the answer is POST.
